events.title: Bradford Councillor Stabbed; Man Charged With Attempted Murder
events.summary: Bradford councillor Ibrar Ali was stabbed on 19 November. Arfan Ali was charged with attempted murder and appeared before magistrates on 21 November. Police have not stated a motive.

events.title: US Soldier Arrested By UK Police On Suspicion Of Spying Is Handed To US Military
events.summary: A US soldier arrested by UK police on suspicion of spying was taken into custody by the US military, the Metropolitan Police said on 17 November, citing suspected national security and espionage allegations. Sky News reported that he was suspected of spying for Russia; the police have not stated that allegation.

events.title: US Forces At RAF Lakenheath Shelter After Suspected Drone Activity
events.summary: The US Air Force said it responded to suspected unauthorised drone activity at RAF Lakenheath in Suffolk on the evening of 13 November. Sirens sounded and US personnel at the base, a major airfield used by the US Air Force in the UK, were told to take shelter. The US military said there were no injuries or damage. It has not said who was operating the drones.

events.title: Global Microsoft Outage Disrupts UK Police, Schools And Health Services
events.summary: A global outage of Microsoft 365 services, including Outlook and Teams, that began on 12 November disrupted public services across the UK into 13 November. The Metropolitan Police said it was not receiving reports through its websites, and police urged the public to call 101 or 999 instead of reporting online. GP practices, schools and NHS organisations reported problems with email and communications; reports differed on whether clinical systems were affected. Microsoft said the incident did not appear to be the result of a cyberattack.

events.title: Two Iranian Men Convicted Of Spying On Iran International Journalists
events.summary: Two Iranian men were found guilty at Woolwich Crown Court on 12 November of offences under the National Security Act after carrying out surveillance on journalists at Iran International, a London-based Persian-language broadcaster. Mostafa Sepahvand, 41, was convicted of two offences and Farhad Javadi Manesh, 46, of one, assisting a foreign intelligence service; a third man, Shapoor Qalehali Khani Noori, 57, was cleared. Prosecutors said Sepahvand intended to carry out a violent attack on at least one target. Police said it was the first time Iranian nationals had been convicted under the act.

events.title: UK Economy Grows 0.7 Percent, Fastest In More Than Two Years
events.summary: The UK economy grew by 0.7 percent in the three months to September, its fastest quarterly pace in more than two years, the Office for National Statistics said on 12 November. Services grew 0.9 percent, while construction fell 0.7 percent. Both outlets reported that AI-related activity helped lift growth. The economy grew 0.2 percent in September alone.

events.title: Hoax Bomb Threats Emailed To Hundreds Of Schools In Scotland And Northern Ireland
events.summary: Hundreds of schools in Scotland and Northern Ireland received hoax bomb threats by email on 11 November, and some were evacuated as a precaution. Police Scotland said about 1,000 schools received the email and that the warnings were immediately assessed as hoaxes. Similar hoax threats had been made to schools last month.

events.title: US Army Member Arrested Near Gloucester In Russia-Linked Inquiry
events.summary: A 41-year-old member of the US Army was arrested near Gloucester on 10 November on suspicion of offences under the National Security Act, the Metropolitan Police said. Police said the allegations relate to Russia and that the investigation is being carried out with US authorities, including the FBI. Officers searched two locations in Gloucestershire.

events.title: Bank Of England Raises Interest Rates For First Time Since 2023
events.summary: The Bank of England's Monetary Policy Committee voted 8–1 to raise Bank Rate by a quarter point to 4 percent, announced on 5 November, its first increase since August 2023. One member voted for a larger rise, to 4.25 percent. The Bank said global energy prices had continued to rise as the conflict in the Middle East entered its ninth month.

events.title: Hundreds Arrested At London Protest Backing Banned Palestine Action
events.summary: The Metropolitan Police arrested 325 people at a demonstration outside the US Embassy in London on 31 October, 320 of them for showing support for Palestine Action, a group banned by the government in 2025. The protest, organised by Defend Our Juries, came days before a Supreme Court hearing on the ban. Police had warned beforehand that anyone showing support for the group faced arrest.
